description: The text read from a tender's documentation (SWZ, OPZ and attachments; the specification first), by tender_id or public slug, 20000 characters per call (pass next_offset as offset for the rest), with the list of documents it came from. When there is no text, documents_status and message say why (no documents, or not read yet) and copy_with_documents points to the same tender from another portal that has them. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

slug.description: public slug, when there is no tender_id
